outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluations failed 0/162, so there is no discordant official outcome. The main observed process difference is that the parallel-mode run was actually a single-agent run that timed out before final verification and final response, while the serial run completed, performed broader differential testing, and consciously accepted at least one exact-output mismatch. Those differences explain different solution lifecycles, but not a pass/fail split.
